column1: # Curated transporter KO -> substrate compound assignments for metabolite -> gene TRANSPORTER links.
# KEGG BRITE ko02000 (Transporters) classifies KOs into transporter families but records NO substrate
# compounds, so the substrate is a curation step, recorded here row by row. `aree build-metabolite-links`
# checks every KO below against ko02000 (a KO absent from ko02000 is rejected and listed in provenance).
#   ko_definition    the KEGG KO definition itself names the compound (e.g. "facilitated glucose transporter")
#   substrate_class  the definition names a substrate class (e.g. "monocarboxylic acid"); the compound is the
#                    curator's call from the characterized human members, given in human_ortholog
# Every transporter link is 'inferred': substrate specificity of the oyster ortholog has not been measured.
# Only compounds that are also in metabolite_compound_map.tsv are used. See docs/metabolite_gene_links.md.
